children: Charging agreed to sell a 51% stake in its Charging Israel unit for $2.5 million and will retain a 49% interest while Charging Israel receives a $1.5 million loan from buyer.
Charging Israel issued 149 ordinary shares to Clearmind for $2.5M ($16,778 per share), giving Clearmind 51% ownership.
Charging will retain a 49% equity interest; Charging Israel will be deconsolidated from Charging's financials.
Clearmind will provide a $1.5M loan to Charging Israel at 4.0% interest, maturing in three years with automatic extension if cash flow insufficient.
Pro forma financials show a $4.865M gain on deconsolidation for the year ended 2025 and changes to assets/liabilities and net income.
